description: This figure group is composite, mixing three presentations of the mechanical behaviour of Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni low-density steel. (a) is an SEM micrograph (labelled "(a)", 20 µm scale bar, secondary-electron contrast) of a rough fracture cross-section containing several spherical, partly unfused powder particles indicated by a black arrow, an angular feature annotated "Crack", and rough surrounding fracture surface. (b) is a grouped bar chart of "Hardness/HV" (y-axis 200–320) versus samples P-70, P-90, P-110, P-130 and P-150, with two gradient-shaded series legend-labelled "Longitudinal" and "Cross", error bars on every bar, and printed values 279/278, 289/285, 294/292, 284/283 and 283/281 HV respectively. (c) is a table with columns Sample, YS/MPa, TS/MPa, Z/% and EL/% for rows P-70 to P-150 and As-cast. Hardness peaks at P-110 (294 longitudinal, 292 cross), and the table shows P-110 is also strongest (YS 887.1 MPa, TS 1076.8 MPa, EL 40.80%), while As-cast is weakest (TS 879.0 MPa, Z 17.10%, EL 20.53%). Together the panels argue that ~110 W laser power optimises strength, ductility and hardness, with the pores, cracks and unfused powder seen in (a) plus grain size invoked to explain the loss of hardness at higher and lower power.

observations.observation: The hardness bar chart y-axis is labelled 'Hardness/HV' with gridlines and ticks from 200 to 320 in steps of 20.
The bar chart x-axis categories are P-70, P-90, P-110, P-130 and P-150, and the legend distinguishes 'Longitudinal' and 'Cross' series, each bar carrying an error bar.
Printed hardness values on the bars are 279 and 278 HV (P-70), 289 and 285 HV (P-90), 294 and 292 HV (P-110), 284 and 283 HV (P-130), and 283 and 281 HV (P-150).
Hardness reaches its maximum at P-110 (294 HV for the left-hand longitudinal bar and 292 HV for the right-hand cross bar) and falls for both higher and lower laser powers.
The mechanical-property table lists row P-110 with YS 887.1 MPa, TS 1076.8 MPa, Z 35.16% and EL 40.80%, the highest YS, TS and EL of all rows.
The As-cast row is weakest, with YS 772.3 MPa, TS 879.0 MPa, Z 17.10% and EL 20.53%.
Panel (a) is an SEM micrograph with a 20 µm scale bar showing spherical unfused powder particles (black arrow) and a feature labelled 'Crack' in a rough fracture surface.
The caption states the figure reports average hardness values of the cross-sections and longitudinal sections of Fe–30Mn–9Al–C–3Ni alloys SLM-printed at various laser powers.
The caption states a maximum hardness value of 294 HV and an elongation of 40.80%.
The citing text states that both average hardnesses initially increase as laser power rises from 70 to 110 W and then decrease as power is further increased.

The citing text states the P-110 sample exhibited maximum hardness values of 292 and 294 HV for its cross-sectional and longitudinal sections, respectively, and that the side surface was softer than the top surface.
The citing text attributes hardness variation to both grain size and internal defects (pores, cracks and unfused powder particles).

Note: the table's header/label order and the bar-chart legend order are not identical to the caption's 'cross-sections and longitudinal sections' phrasing; the cross/longitudinal assignment of the two series is inferred partly from the citing text and is reported with reduced confidence.
